response.sql:
WITH order_avgs AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as overall_avg
  FROM order_avgs
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    oa.avg_fillcount,
    oa.avg_fillcount - ov.overall_avg as margin_vs_overall
  FROM order_avgs oa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg ov
  WHERE oa.avg_fillcount > ov.overall_avg
),
second_group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as second_avg
  FROM first_filter
),
second_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    ff.avg_fillcount,
    ff.margin_vs_overall,
    ff.avg_fillcount - sga.second_avg as margin_vs_second
  FROM first_filter ff
  CROSS JOIN second_group_avg sga
  WHERE ff.avg_fillcount > sga.second_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_fillcount),
  AVG(margin_vs_overall),
  AVG(margin_vs_second)
FROM second_filter;

assumptions.assumption: "The average across all orders" means the average of per-order averages (each order weighted equally), not the overall average of all executions (each fill weighted equally).

alternatives.interpretation: "The average across all orders" means the overall average fillcount across all execution records in orderexecutions, treating fills equally regardless of which order they belong to.
